notable_claims: Proposed university policy would grant administration access to computer files of students deemed suspicious without sufficient checks and balances.
classification.summary: A report from the McGill Tribune details student concerns over proposed revisions to the Code of Student Conduct and Discipline. Specifically, a proposed amendment to Article 12(b) would allow the university to access students' computer files if they are accused of fraud or misconduct, removing expectations of privilege and confidentiality.
classification.title: Computer file privacy at McGill U. in Canada
